# Future Vision Computer Institute

> Computer training institute in Surat, Gujarat, India, teaching Python, data science, data analytics, agentic AI, accounting, graphic design and digital marketing. Established 2006. Courses run in-centre in Surat and as live online sessions, in 1-on-1 and small group formats, with study material included.

Contact: +91 98257 71678 · futurevisioncomputersinstitute@gmail.com
Location: 115, Raj Victoria Complex, Pal Gam Circle, Surat, Gujarat, India
Branches: Pal, Vesu, Citylight

## Courses

- [Python Foundations Program](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/python-foundation/): Python from zero — syntax, logic, data structures and real problem solving, for people who have never coded. 1.5 months, beginner. From ₹7,000.
- [Professional Python Developer](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/professionalpythondeveloper/): Python, OOP, advanced SQL, Flask and AI tools for building real backend applications. 4 months, beginner to job-ready. From ₹26,500.
- [Advanced Certificate in Python & Agentic AI](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/pythonagentic-ai/): Python through machine learning, generative AI and autonomous agentic AI systems, using LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI and Claude. 11 months, advanced, ends in placement support. ₹77,000.
- [C Programming Course](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/c-programming/): C as the foundation language for logic building and system programming. 1 month, beginner. From ₹7,000.
- [C++ Programming Course](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/cpp-programming/): Object-oriented programming in C++ for strong fundamentals and DSA readiness. 1 month, intermediate. From ₹7,000.
- [Advanced Excel & Power BI](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/excel-powerbi/): Advanced Excel combined with Power BI for reporting and dashboards. 2 months, beginner. From ₹7,200.
- [Power BI](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/power-bi/): Business reporting and dashboard building in Power BI. 4 weeks. From ₹7,000.
- [Business Analytics Course](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/business-analytics/): Turning business data into decisions with Excel, Power BI and AI automation. 3 months, beginner to job-ready. From ₹25,600.
- [Advanced Data Analytics](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/data-analytics/): Deep-dive analytics with Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python, statistics and agentic AI on real datasets, aimed at Data Analyst roles. 6 months, advanced, ends in placement support. From ₹52,000.
- [Advanced Certificate in Data Science & Agentic AI](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/data-science/): Statistics, machine learning, deep learning, NLP and agentic AI, with Python and TensorFlow. 11 months, advanced, ends in placement support. ₹77,000.
- [Advanced Computer Accounting with GST & Zoho Books](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/advanced-computer-accounting/): Computerised accounting with GST and cloud bookkeeping in Zoho Books. 3 months, beginner to job-ready. From ₹6,000.
- [Professional Business Finance & Accounting](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/business-finance-accounting/): Practical business finance, accounting principles and financial reporting. 4 months, beginner to job-ready. ₹28,000.
- [Tally Prime with GST](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/tally-prime-gst/): Accounting, billing, inventory, payroll, TDS and GST reporting in Tally Prime. 4 weeks. ₹6,000.
- [Advanced Graphic Designing with Gen AI](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/graphic-designing/): Adobe, Canva, Figma and Claude AI for designing faster and building a career-ready portfolio. 4-9 months, beginner to advanced, ends in placement support. From ₹21,600.
- [Basic Graphic Designing Course](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/graphic-designing/): Core design principles, typography and tools for starting a design career. 2 months, beginner.
- [Digital Marketing with Strategies & Business Automation](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/digital-marketing-seo/): Full-funnel digital marketing, growth strategy and business automation, covering SEO, paid ads and automation tooling. 4 months, advanced, ends in placement support. ₹28,000.
- [Computer Basics & Gen AI Foundation](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/computer-basics-genai/): Computer fundamentals plus a hands-on introduction to generative AI tools. 1.5 months, beginner. ₹6,000.
- [Professional Office & Generative AI Essentials](https://futurevisioncomputers.com/professional-office-genai/): MS Office and everyday generative AI tools for the modern workplace. 2 months, beginner. ₹7,200.

## Courses without a page of their own

These run at the institute but have no dedicated page yet, so ask directly for fees and batch dates.

- Advanced Certificate in Digital Design & Marketing with Gen AI: design, content and digital marketing supercharged with generative AI. 9 months, advanced, ends in placement support.
- Advanced Certificate in Digital Design & Advertisement with Gen AI: Photoshop, Illustrator, motion, CGI ads and AI-powered advertising campaigns. 9 months, advanced, ends in placement support.

## Notes

Fees above are the current advertised price in Indian rupees and are the figure a student pays; several courses price per delivery mode, so the lowest plan is quoted as "From". Durations are the advertised course length. Confirm current fees and batch dates with the institute directly.

Basic Graphic Designing and Advanced Graphic Designing with Gen AI are two separate courses that currently share one page, so that link covers both.

No fee is listed for Basic Graphic Designing because the shared page prices the advanced programme; ask the institute for it.
